about: The offertorium of the formulary “21st Sunday after Pentecost” in the 1962 Roman Missal.

seg.tr: In the land of Uz there was a man named Job, guileless and upright, one who feared God. Satan asked for him, that he might test him; and power over his goods and over his flesh was given to him by the Lord; and he destroyed all his possessions, and his children; he also wounded his flesh with a grievous sore.
